children.text: Most growing businesses eventually hit the same problem: sales, inventory, purchase, accounting, HR, manufacturing, and operations are running in separate tools that do not talk to each other.
Data gets duplicated. Reports take hours. Stock visibility is unclear. Purchase decisions are delayed. Finance waits for operational updates. Managers make decisions from incomplete information.

is an integrated business system that connects CRM, sales, purchase, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, HR, and operations in one platform. KP Infotech implements and customizes Odoo so it fits your real workflows, reporting needs, and growth stage instead of forcing your team into a generic template.
— Pipeline management, quotations, customer records, sales activities, follow-up workflows, and sales reporting.
— Vendor management, purchase requests, RFQs, purchase orders, approval flows, pricing, and procurement visibility.
— Real-time stock visibility, barcode operations, multi-warehouse management, reorder rules, stock transfers, and inventory reporting.
— Invoicing, reconciliation, tax workflows, payment tracking, receivables, payables, and financial reporting connected to operations.
— Bills of materials, production planning, work orders, quality checks, material requirement planning, and shop-floor visibility.
— Employee records, attendance, leave workflows, payroll support, recruitment, approvals, and internal requests.
— Custom modules, reports, dashboards, third-party integrations, API connections, and workflows built around your business needs.

ERP success is not just configuration. It requires clean data, mapped workflows, clear user roles, training, reporting, and ongoing support. We help teams move from scattered operations to a system they can actually use every day.
Whether you are starting from spreadsheets, legacy software, or disconnected SaaS tools, KP Infotech plans the migration carefully and protects business continuity during the transition.

faqs.answer: Odoo offers a wide set of business modules with strong customization flexibility, making it useful for growing companies that need ERP without the cost and complexity of many large enterprise systems.
faqs.question: Why choose Odoo ERP for a growing business?

faqs.answer: Yes. We configure existing modules, build custom modules, create reports, and integrate Odoo with other systems when standard functionality does not fully match your process.
faqs.question: Can KP Infotech customize Odoo for our workflows?

faqs.answer: Yes. Odoo can support manufacturing, MRP, inventory, warehouse, purchase, vendor management, production planning, and stock visibility workflows when implemented around the right process design.
faqs.question: Can Odoo support manufacturing, inventory, and purchase workflows?

faqs.answer: Yes. We plan and validate data migration from spreadsheets, legacy ERPs, CRMs, accounting tools, inventory systems, and other operational databases.
faqs.question: Can you migrate data from spreadsheets or legacy software?

faqs.answer: Yes. We can support cloud deployments for most businesses and on-premise setups where data control, compliance, or infrastructure requirements make that necessary.
